One thing we know for sure, is that though the losses in the Global North will be huge, the impact will be most painful in the Global South.
The Straits of Hormuz, you say. ... oh no! Europe's #1 economy is at the mercy of the Straits of Kaub a narrowing of the river Rhine channel where robber barons once held sway.
